target_subproblem: parts.ii — Σ 1/(x log x) < ∞ for every well-separated A
reference_baseline: Koukoulopoulos-Lamzouri-Lichtman 2025 (arXiv:2502.09539) — GCD-graphs + Selberg sieve; achieves S1 ≪ log N / sqrt(log log N); falls (log log N)^(1/2 + ε) short of forcing parts.ii via Abel summation.
search_objective: Find an MDL-native morphism orthogonal to KLL's GCD-graph framing that potentially yields a structurally different attack architecture for parts.ii.

candidates.name: Channel-occupancy under multiplicative action
candidates.mdl_primitive: 1-wide forbidden zone per x under integer-dilation k·x; total occupancy = Σ 1/x.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Nothing — recovers KLL's o(log N) bound exactly.
candidates.gate_1_verdict: GREEN (genuine MDL framing) but KLL-EQUIVALENT (no novel prediction)
candidates.follow_through: deferred — baseline only; informs other candidates

candidates.name: Multiplicative Sidon analogue (B₂[ℓ]-dilation)
candidates.mdl_primitive: View A as a multiplicative Sidon set: integer-dilation collisions replace additive Sidon collisions.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Sidon-rate density bound |A ∩ [1,N]| ≪ √N (or N^(1/2 + o(1))). If true, parts.ii follows trivially.
candidates.prior_art: Erdős 1969 multiplicative Sidon literature; Erdős-Bateman J. Number Theory 1962; Ruzsa B₂ sets; primitive sets (Banks-Martin, Granville). No published recasting of Erdős #143 as multiplicative Sidon.
candidates.gate_1_verdict: YELLOW — heuristically attractive but technical content likely converges to KLL counting unless Sidon-quality machinery materializes
candidates.gate_2_strategy: Need new incidence/energy bounds for the relation (x,y,k) with |kx - y| < 1; need multiplicative analogue of Cilleruelo/Ruzsa/Green-Ruzsa Fourier-analytic B₂ machinery. Current technology does NOT give Sidon-level bounds for primitive-like multiplicative constraints.

numerical_signal.test: compute |A ∩ [1,N]| / √N across decades for greedy near-WS set |A|=1500 up to N=10^8
numerical_signal.interpretation: STRONG sub-Sidon behavior observed (ratio decays monotonically below 1.0); consistent with M2 prediction but does NOT prove it

candidates.session_verdict: PROMISING-but-TECHNICALLY-BLOCKED. Strong numerical signal, missing analytical handle.
candidates.follow_through: WORTH PURSUING — but requires breakthrough in multiplicative-Sidon sieve technique. Out of session scope.

candidates.name: Logarithmic-position aperiodic point process
candidates.mdl_primitive: Map x → log x; WS becomes 'log-positions form an aperiodic point process under integer scaling by log k'.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Low self-correlation of {log x : x ∈ A} under integer log-shifts; possibly zero-entropy under ℤ⁺-action; weighted bounds Σ f(log x)/x going beyond KLL's sieve.
candidates.prior_art: Log map appears in probabilistic number theory (Montgomery-Odlyzko); Furstenberg correspondence for multiplicative structures (Tao, Frantzikinakis-Host) — but those concern multiplicative function values, not the dilation-avoidance constraint of #143. No explicit log(A)-as-point-process treatment of #143 in literature.
candidates.gate_1_verdict: GREEN — genuinely orthogonal framing (moves from arithmetic combinatorics to dynamical systems on ℝ with constraints under multiplication by log k)
candidates.gate_2_strategy: Tools: ergodic theory for ℤ^d-actions with rigidity/aperiodicity constraints; spectral methods for point processes (Palm measures, correlation functions). GAP: translating L²-spectral estimates into arithmetic bounds on Σ 1/(x log x). No standard machinery yet.

numerical_signal.test: lattice-mode power |Σ exp(i·t·log x)|²/|A| for integer t = 1..10
numerical_signal.interpretation: MIXED — small-shift lattice modes (t=1,2,3) are ELEVATED (clustering at log-scale ratios e, e², e³), larger shifts mostly suppressed. NOT clean aperiodicity. Suggests greedy WS has natural log-spacing preferences that are NOT Poisson.
numerical_signal.caveat: Tested only on greedy near-WS construction; cannot generalize to all WS sets.

candidates.session_verdict: GENUINELY-ORTHOGONAL-but-MIXED-SIGNAL. Theoretical framework is novel; experimental signature is messy.
candidates.follow_through: WORTH PURSUING with cleaner WS constructions (e.g., explicit number-theoretic examples) to verify whether the lattice modes at small t are an artifact of greedy construction or genuine WS structure.

candidates.name: Anti-Beatty / forbidden-density
candidates.mdl_primitive: WS sets exclude infinite Beatty sequences; encode WS as co-Beatty constraint.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Qualitative: A cannot shadow any Beatty sequence too often. Quantitative parts.ii statement requires a transference principle that does not exist.
candidates.prior_art: Beatty/Sturmian classical (Rayleigh, Weyl, Niven-Zuckerman-Montgomery). KLL do not use Beatty/Sturmian descriptions. No published transference principle connecting harmonic-sum mass to Beatty correlation in multiplicative context.
candidates.gate_1_verdict: RED — likely a rephrasing of density constraints; no concrete proof handle
candidates.follow_through: DROPPED — least concrete, closest to KLL repackaging.

candidates.name: Information-theoretic entropy decay
candidates.mdl_primitive: Encode A as bit-string 𝟙_A : ℕ → {0,1}; WS gives explicit forbidden finite patterns; bound entropy rate.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Upper Banach density of A is 0 + zero entropy rate ⟹ counting function is n^o(1) ⟹ parts.ii follows.
candidates.prior_art: Entropy + forbidden patterns standard in symbolic dynamics (SFTs, sofic shifts). Entropy methods for multiplicative functions (Tao-Teräväinen, Frantzikinakis-Host). No explicit entropy-rate treatment of 𝟙_A(n) with pattern constraints from |kx - y| ≥ 1.
candidates.gate_2_strategy: Tools: subadditive entropy bounds; SFT-style arguments adapted for nonlocal interactions; Ornstein-Weiss / Gurevich entropy for countable-state shifts. GAP: WS is a global multiplicative constraint, not a finite-radius local pattern — turning this into a usable entropy bound is non-trivial; no off-the-shelf theory.

numerical_signal.test: compute Shannon binary entropy per integer-bin on dyadic blocks [2^k, 2^(k+1)) for k=2..25
numerical_signal.interpretation: WEAK — per-bin entropy decays as expected from density (≈ p log(1/p)), but total block entropy grows ~linearly in k=log N. No sub-counting entropy structure surfaces. Greedy WS has approximately 1 bit per element of entropy — consistent with finite positive entropy rate per element, not the entropy-rate-zero prediction.

candidates.session_verdict: TRULY-ORTHOGONAL-but-EXPERIMENTALLY-WEAK. Framing is novel; numerical entropy structure doesn't surface beyond counting.
candidates.follow_through: DEFERRED — would need explicit WS subshift construction with a finitely-described forbidden-pattern family, then SFT-style bounds. Out of session scope.

candidates.name: Koopman / Transfer-operator spectral
candidates.mdl_primitive: WS as a spectral constraint on a dilation transfer operator T_k acting on a suitable Hilbert/Banach space; harmonic sums as moments under invariant measure.
candidates.predicts_beyond_kll: Spectral radius of dilation operator strictly less than 1 in relevant direction ⟹ exponential decay of correlations ⟹ exponential or power-savings in counts of kx ≈ y ⟹ much stronger than KLL's o(log N / √log log N). Could give convergence of Σ x^(-s) for s near 1 — well beyond parts.ii.
candidates.prior_art: Koopman + transfer operators standard in ergodic theory + dynamical zeta functions; for multiplicative problems see thermodynamic formalism on squarefree numbers (Baladi, Mayer for Gauss map). NO standard Koopman-operator framing for Erdős #143 or primitive sets in literature. KLL do not use spectral theory of operators.
candidates.gate_1_verdict: GREEN — MOST orthogonal to KLL of all candidates
candidates.gate_2_strategy: Need: (i) a precise dynamical system whose invariant sets correspond to WS sets, (ii) a function space where the dilation transfer operator is quasi-compact with a spectral gap, (iii) thermodynamic formalism / Dolgopyat-type estimates for the gap. GAP: building such a system is highly non-trivial — there is no canonical Markov partition or symbolic coding as in continued fractions. Heavy-duty analysis required.
candidates.numerical_signal: NOT TESTED — building a finite-sample transfer operator for WS sets is significantly more complex than the other M-candidate experiments; deferred to follow-up work.
candidates.portfolio_bias_check: H² portfolio favors Koopman-von Neumann framings (RPQEC, Mendoza Conjecture, KvN bridge). Perplexity rank-1 may be inflated by this bias. Gate 5 should explicitly weight this.
candidates.session_verdict: MOST-PROMISING-RESEARCH-DIRECTION. Theoretically novel + highest predictive ceiling, but most ambitious technically and at risk of portfolio bias.
candidates.follow_through: STRONGEST CANDIDATE FOR EXTERNAL HAND-OFF. Construction of the dilation transfer operator is a research project in its own right; warrants Lamzouri/Lichtman consultation (KLL co-authors) on whether the spectral framing complements their sieve.

gate_5_synthesis.rationale: The orthogonal search identified three GREEN candidates (M3, M5, M6) and one YELLOW candidate (M2), none of which yields a tractable proof architecture closeable in a session. M6 (Koopman) is the most genuinely orthogonal and has the highest predictive ceiling but requires building dynamical-system infrastructure from scratch. M2 (Sidon analogue) has the strongest experimental signal but no analytical handle. M3 (log-process) is genuinely novel but experimentally mixed. M5 (entropy) is philosophically orthogonal but lacks sub-counting numerical signal. M4 (anti-Beatty) is a rephrasing.
gate_5_synthesis.most_promising_research_thread: M6 (Koopman / transfer-operator spectral) — for theoretical orthogonality + highest predictive ceiling. Caveat: portfolio bias acknowledged.
gate_5_synthesis.second_thread: M2 (multiplicative Sidon analogue) — for experimental signal + concrete predicted bound. Requires Sidon-quality sieve technique that does not yet exist.
gate_5_synthesis.what_search_did_NOT_yield: No candidate produced a clean conditional reduction lemma comparable to lemmas.parts_ii_of_strengthened_S1 that closes via Athena/Codex in a session. Stage 4 is SKIP for this pass.
gate_5_synthesis.what_KLL_still_owns: KLL remains the state of the art. No MDL morphism in this inventory bypasses their machinery; all viable alternatives are speculative research programs, not session-attackable proof paths.
gate_5_synthesis.honest_summary: PARTIAL_PROGRESS via research direction. Search produced a ranked menu of orthogonal attack architectures suitable for external collaborator hand-off (Lamzouri, Lichtman) or follow-up sessions, but did not close any sorry and did not surface a near-term proof path.

stage_4_decision: SKIP — no candidate produced a tractable conditional reduction lemma worth scaffolding in 143.lean.

candidate.name: Von Neumann entropy on bipartite dilation channel (with pinching-identity / Holevo bound)
candidate.mdl_primitive: Build bipartite Hilbert space ℋ_A ⊗ ℋ_K with |ψ⟩_AK = (1/√Z) Σ_x Σ_k α(x,k) |x⟩|k⟩, α(x,k) = 1 if k·x ≤ N. Partial-trace gives ρ_A; WS forbids collision rows in amplitude matrix. Apply VN entropy, SSA, Araki-Lieb.
candidate.predicts_beyond_kll: Sub-maximal entanglement entropy S(ρ_A) ≪ log|A|; mutual information I(A:K) constrained by WS-specific arithmetic; potentially tighter than KLL via quantum-information inequalities specific to the dilation structure.
candidate.prior_art: No published recasting of Selberg sieve as VN entropy bound (Perplexity Q1 confirmed). Closest related: classical Shannon entropy in additive combinatorics (Madiman, Kontoyiannis, Tao-Vu); spectral graph theory in KLL (GCD graphs). H² portfolio infrastructure: Math/Lean4/MendozaLab/PinchingIdentity.lean (the §101 patent shield establishing S_VN = H_Shannon on eigenvalues).
candidate.gate_1_verdict: RED — universal quantum-information inequalities (SSA, Araki-Lieb, subadditivity) wash out the GCD/congruence structure that's load-bearing in KLL. The arithmetic content lives entirely in the Gram-matrix entries; quantum entropy machinery is generic and captures no novel arithmetic constraint.
candidate.perplexity_verdict_q2: M7 is a notational reformulation that repackages the same eigenvalue constraints, not an orthogonal route that yields a strictly stronger Σ 1/(x log x)-type bound. Any genuinely novel inequality would need to be non-universal (multiplicative-number-theory-specific) — does not exist in current literature.
candidate.perplexity_verdict_q3: I(A:K) = 2 S(ρ_A) for pure states is invariant under unitaries on ℋ_K; universal quantum inequalities don't see arithmetic placement of dilation indices. Selberg sieve, by contrast, is exquisitely sensitive to congruence structure.

numerical_signal.test: naive bipartite indicator α(x,k)=1, varying |A| 100→1000 and N 10^4→10^8
numerical_signal.interpretation: Bipartite state is approximately a product state (effective_rank → 1.4 as |A| grows). VN/log|A| → 0.05. Mutual information I(A:K) ≈ 0.66 bits at |A|=1000 — nearly zero entanglement.
numerical_signal.WS_specificity: Low — the near-product structure is a property of the dilation indicator α (for x near N only k=1 works), not of the WS arithmetic. Any sparse set in [1,N] would give similar near-product structure. WS arithmetic is washed out.

candidate.session_verdict: NOTATIONAL — drops with M4 to the 'rephrasing' column. Important negative result for the H² portfolio: the KvN / VN-entropy infrastructure is real for spectral patent applications but does NOT translate into a new attack on parts.ii.
candidate.what_might_work: A non-universal quantum-info inequality specific to multiplicative number theory — not yet developed. Building one would itself be a research project comparable in scope to M6 (Koopman framework). Both routes require establishing arithmetic-specific operator theory rather than invoking generic quantum-info machinery.
candidate.portfolio_bias_note: The H² portfolio has PinchingIdentity.lean and treats VN-entropy framings favorably. This made M7 a natural candidate to consider; both the Perplexity analysis and the numerical experiment converged on the negative verdict despite that bias. This is honest evidence the portfolio framework has limits.

follow_up_pass_M7.impact_on_most_promising_thread: M6 (Koopman) remains #1; M7 demonstrates that NAIVE quantum-info approaches reduce to KLL via the pinching identity, so M6's strict orthogonality requires explicit thermodynamic-formalism construction (not just borrowing VN-entropy formalism).
follow_up_pass_M7.lesson_for_h2_portfolio: The §101 PinchingIdentity shield is a patent / formalization tool; it does NOT auto-produce new analytic-number-theory bounds. Universal quantum-info inequalities (SSA, Araki-Lieb, subadditivity) are too coarse for multiplicative-number-theory problems where the constraint is congruence-structured.
